svg.text: Input: 아니ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 이거 진짜 너무 웃긴데
Each block uses the same 3×3 canvas. English fills it with letters; Korean fills it with jamo, the alphabet-like pieces inside Hangul syllables.
Fill colors replace letterforms. Bottom bars mark chat cues built for colloquial written language: reaction, emphasis, and shorthand.
surface chunks = flat visible units; structure groups = 3×3 capacity-based blocks. token tax saved = surface − groups; Δ = groups − surface.
